I told Dana the latest figure is **100 seats**. I replied in a thread on their message in #north-team.

- **Where it came from:** Ilse posted 261 seats in #north-team on Oct 14. The same morning, Ilse posted a correction in #north-random saying the 2026 renewal is 100 seats and the 261 came from the wrong line. Dana is a member of both channels, so I only used messages Dana can already see.
- **Not confirmed as final:** neither of Ilse's posts says the number is settled. I found no Quarrendon contract or order form to check it against. Dana can't see any Quarrendon account files, and none of the visible notes or digests cover the 2026 renewal. So I suggested Dana ask Ilse to confirm before marking it settled in the tracker.
- **Knowledge base:** it now has two Quarrendon seat counts: the 261 I saved earlier and an entry saying 100 that corrects it. The 261 entry isn't marked as replaced, so anyone looking it up later will see both numbers.
